description: Account delete and ban integration with Razorpay AutoPay (F7, D9, scenario row 23): delete cancels every live AutoPay before sa_delete_account and refuses if Razorpay cancel fails; ban (server-enforced confirmation) cancels AutoPay immediately after banning and reports the outcome. Implements plan.md step 4. Depends on FEAT-001 (admin-status.ts LIVE_AUTOPAY_STATUSES, admin-db.ts adminAudit, the migration's billing_admin_audit).
steps: Read plan.md design decisions 4-9 and step 4, and FEAT-001's findings.

Create src/lib/billing/razorpay/account-autopay.ts: listLiveAutopay, AutopayCancelError, cancelLiveAutopayForAccount with the exact rules and messages in plan.md step 4 (live statuses created/authenticated/active/pending/halted/paused; fresh initiating < 15 min refuses; unconfigured or other mode refuses before ANY cancel; tolerate isAlreadyInState/isNotFound; markCancelRequested(id,'admin'); best-effort syncSubscription(deps,pid,'admin'); ban context writes an adminAudit row).

Wire src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/route.ts DELETE: after assertDeletable and before deleteAccountRecords call cancelLiveAutopayForAccount(context 'account_delete'); map AutopayCancelError to {error, code} with its status and no-store; add autopay_cancelled to the success response.
src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/delete/verify/route.ts: add live_autopay to the success response.

src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/ban/route.ts POST: add isSameOrigin and isUuid, the 409 autopay_confirmation_required handshake (no ban without confirmAutopayCancel:true when a live AutoPay with a provider id exists), banAccount first, then cancel, autopay outcome none|cancelled|failed, notifyAdmin billing_anomaly on failure, after() email delivery when something was cancelled. Leave DELETE (unban) unchanged.

UI: src/app/(super-admin)/super-admin/accounts/[id]/page.tsx handleBanToggle second confirm + resend + outcome toasts; src/components/super-admin/accounts/delete-account-dialog.tsx note listing live_autopay after the password step. Copy exactly as plan.md step 4, no exclamation marks, no em dashes.

Tests: new src/lib/billing/razorpay/account-autopay.test.ts; extend src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/delete-account.test.ts (cancel happens before sa_delete_account, refusal on Razorpay failure and on unreachable mode with sa_delete_account not called, verify returns live_autopay); new src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/ban/ban-route.test.ts (403 non-super-admin, 403 cross-origin, 409 confirmation required without banning, ban then cancel, failure reported + notifyAdmin, no AutoPay -> none).
Run this FEAT's verification commands; eslint and prettier on touched files only.
acceptance_criteria: A test proves the delete route calls the AutoPay cancel before sa_delete_account
A test proves the delete is refused (sa_delete_account not called) when the Razorpay cancel fails with a non-tolerated error, with a clear error message naming the subscription
A test proves banning with a live AutoPay requires confirmAutopayCancel and then cancels the AutoPay, reporting autopay.outcome
Existing delete-account tests still pass unchanged in intent
findings:
BUILT: src/lib/billing/razorpay/account-autopay.ts exports listLiveAutopay(admin, accountId) (billing_subscriptions, columns LIVE_AUTOPAY_COLUMNS = id, account_id, mode, status, provider_subscription_id, created_at, plan_name, cycle_label; .eq(account_id).in(status, LIVE_AUTOPAY_STATUSES + initiating)), cancellableAutopay(rows) (live status AND provider id), getAutopayDeps() (BillingDeps or null when getRazorpayConfig() is null), AutopayCancelError(code, message, status), cancelLiveAutopayForAccount({admin, getDeps, accountId, actorUserId, context, reason, now?}) -> {outcome:none} | {outcome:cancelled, cancelled:[{id, providerSubscriptionId, mode, alreadyCancelled}]}. Order: fresh initiating (<15 min) -> checkout_in_progress 409; reachability checked for ALL cancellable rows before any cancel (unconfigured or other mode -> autopay_unreachable 409, getDeps only called when something needs cancelling); per row cancelSubscription(pid,false) tolerating isAlreadyInState||isNotFound, markCancelRequested(id,admin), best-effort syncSubscription(deps,pid,admin), and for account_ban an adminAudit row; any other error -> autopay_cancel_failed 502 with the delete or ban wording from plan.md (trailing period of Razorpay message trimmed so the sentence reads cleanly).
DELETE /api/super-admin/accounts/[id]: cancel runs after assertDeletable and before deleteAccountRecords; AutopayCancelError mapped to {error, code} + status + no-store; success adds autopay_cancelled: string[] (provider ids); console.warn when anything was cancelled. No email on delete (outbox cascades).
POST delete/verify: success adds live_autopay: [{mode, status, provider_subscription_id}] (cancellable rows only; stale initiating not listed).
POST ban: requireSuperAdmin -> isSameOrigin (403 {error:Forbidden, code:bad_origin}) -> isUuid (400) -> listLiveAutopay; cancellable rows and confirmAutopayCancel !== true -> 409 autopay_confirmation_required with autopay list, no ban. Otherwise banAccount, then cancelLiveAutopayForAccount(account_ban). Response {success:true, message:Account banned, autopay} where autopay is {outcome:none} | {outcome:cancelled, cancelled} | {outcome:failed, code, message}. On failure: billing_anomaly notifyAdmin (warning, title Account banned but AutoPay was not cancelled, body = message, accountId). When cancelled: after() -> deliverBillingEmails(getEventDeps(), {limit:5}). Route now exports runtime nodejs and dynamic force-dynamic; responses no-store. DELETE (unban) unchanged.
UI: account page handleBanToggle resends with confirmAutopayCancel:true after a second destructive confirm (copy from plan.md, label uses first row status + Test mode/Live mode), shows server error text, toasts cancelled/failed per plan (failed uses toast.warning). Delete dialog stores live_autopay from verify and shows an amber role=note on the confirm and final steps.
DEVIATIONS: (1) A non-AutopayCancelError thrown during the ban-time cancel (e.g. a DB error from markCancelRequested) is also reported as outcome failed with code autopay_cancel_failed and message "AutoPay could not be cancelled: <error>", so the ban response stays 200 since the ban already happened. (2) A fresh initiating claim alone does not trigger the ban confirmation (nothing to cancel yet), but the cancel step then reports outcome failed with checkout_in_progress and raises the notification. (3) Ban route imports isSameOrigin from @/lib/super-admin/request-origin (a re-export of @/lib/http/request-origin), matching the other account routes.
TESTS: account-autopay.test.ts 21 tests (query columns asserted; none; each of 6 live statuses cancelled; 4 terminal ignored; fresh vs stale initiating; unconfigured and other-mode unreachable with no Razorpay call and no markCancelRequested; tolerated errors; 5xx exact message and nothing recorded; ban wording; re-read failure tolerated; audit rpc args only for ban). delete-account.test.ts +4 (verify live_autopay; order cancelAutopay before rpc:sa_delete_account and autopay_cancelled; 502 refusal naming the sub with sa_delete_account not called; 409 unreachable not called); existing 9 unchanged and passing. ban/ban-route.test.ts 7 tests (403 non-super-admin; 403 bad_origin for evil and missing Origin with nothing called; 400 bad id; 409 confirmation without ban; ban -> cancel order, context account_ban, after() delivers emails; failure -> 200, outcome failed, notifyAdmin args; none).
VERIFICATION: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" -> no output. npx vitest run src/app/api/super-admin/accounts src/lib/billing/razorpay -> 23 files, 241 tests passed. npx eslint (FEAT-002 paths) -> exit 0, 0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning (page.tsx:139 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps on fetchAccount, not touched). npx prettier --write on the 9 touched files only; no unrelated files reformatted. No live SQL, no Razorpay calls, no migration needed for this feature; .next-verify build not run (not in this FEAT verification list).
